items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: Mills, now Mills was a nice boy, but Mills did a lot of smutty things you see.

ctx.x: Sam Childers? Sam Childers, yeah, he had a tape recorder. That was Dr. Pepper from France, that man's name was Dr. Pepper. That was Dr. Pepper?

Sure. That's his name. Yeah, so look, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand, you see the bandstand facing the wall like this, towards the river. And we had a little room, always to put all the, you know, you come in, you come in in the back, you know, they had a little room, always to put all the airspace. And you know, like you want to leave your ampers, your drum, the thing, or a little room and lock it up. So they came there that night and they took, that man couldn't speak a word…

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: So he hired us to play, well, we played for him.

ctx.x: Get this on here, this is Rio 2 and your kid Thomas Valentine. I don't think we put the date on it before. November the 1st. I think, no we didn't. November the 1st, 1962 it is. Yeah. 62, yeah. Yeah. You're telling us about Mills, how he came back now.

Yeah, Mills, well, yeah, get back to Mills. So Mills, after he came, he started, came from California back here from California. So he hired us to play, well, we played for him. Well, we didn't play that long for him, you know what I mean? But I played quite a while for him when he first had the place, you know, the place for Larry, you know what I mean? Preservation, you see? Well, we played that long time for him. So, yeah. And, uh.
Anything special happen when you were playing for him? No.
